notes.title: A Merry Christmas to All, and some fixes!
notes.content:
I know many people are starting the festive period today, so I wanted to take this opportunity, to wish everyone who has been kind enough to play the game, a very Merry Christmas!

I have also addressed a number of requested fixes, and actioned the following in today's patch:-

Added an 'Epilogue' screen to properly complete the game experience for those who finish the game.

Made adjustments to two checkpoint triggers that could trigger missions prematurely under certain conditions.

Added some optimisations to the Camp Carter mission loop to enable the food store to be located more easily, and moved a checkpoint to enable the first mission to trigger earlier.
 
Added two clues at Cuttler’s Boat Yard to make locating the Steam Achievement, ‘Season Of The Witch’ a fairer challenge.

notes.title: RE: Update 1.5
notes.content: This update could overwrite some users existing save files, so please make a backup of your save files before updating. They can be found on your main drive under USERS-USER-APPDATA-LOCAL-TheQuietApocalypse-SAVED-SaveGames. Drag the 'SaveGames' folder to your desktop to make a copy. Update the game and, if your save games are not showing, start a new game and complete the first objective so the game creates a save folder. Then shut down, and revisit the location that you copied your save games from earlier. Delete the 'SaveGames' folder that is in there and replace with the one from your deskop.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.5 - JOGGING IS HERE!
notes.content:
JOGGING IS HERE! Following multiple requests from players, and concerns about transit times between locations, I have now implemented jogging into the game. 'Left Shift' will now put you into the jogging state, which will cut travel times down by approximately 30%. There is a stamina 'cooldown' during which you will have to walk until your stamina regenerates, but this is very short.

This update could overwrite some users existing save files, so please make a backup of your save files before updating. They can be found on your main drive under USERS-USER-APPDATA-LOCAL-TheQuietApocalypse-SAVED-SaveGames. Drag the 'SaveGames' folder to your desktop to make a copy. Update the game and, if your save games are not showing, start a new game and complete the first objective so the game creates a save folder. Then shut down, and revisit the location that you copied your save games from earlier. Delete the 'SaveGames' folder that is in there and replace with the one from your deskop.
